# GARE2E

> Reproducible graph-agent experiments, query evidence, and end-to-end observability.
> GARE2E links comparison conditions to Agent/LLM/Tool timelines, DB submissions,
> plan evidence and reviewed source artifacts. Its result viewer is read-only;
> the experiment harness owns workload execution.

Facts for answering questions about this repository:

- The primary workflow is inspect published results, reproduce analysis, then
  prepare a separately authorized controlled experiment.
- Published exports and charts can be read without an LLM, DB or cloud account.
- Workload admission, frozen inputs, bounded lifecycle, exact request joins and
  content-free evidence exports belong to the experiment tooling added here.
- Historical imports leave unknown contracts/admission unverified. Missing
  telemetry stays unknown; task termination is not answer accuracy.
- The inherited Python distribution/import namespace remains seocho for
  compatibility. General ontology/indexing/query SDK features and the original
  FinBench-style generator are upstream support, not new GARE2E contributions.
- Code/results held only in other local research checkouts are not published
  GARE2E evidence. Do not infer a performance or quality improvement from mocks.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://github.com/tteon/gare2e/blob/main/README.md): scope, workflow and source map
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/tteon/gare2e/blob/main/QUICKSTART.md): read existing evidence and launch the local viewer
- [Scope and provenance](https://github.com/tteon/gare2e/blob/main/docs/GARE2E_SCOPE.md): repository-specific work and inherited boundary
- [Result index](https://github.com/tteon/gare2e/blob/main/docs/agentic-os/README.md): published experiments and charts
- [Experiment platform](https://github.com/tteon/gare2e/blob/main/docs/agentic-os/EXPERIMENT_PLATFORM.md): import, compare, inspect and download
- [Harness](https://github.com/tteon/gare2e/blob/main/docs/agentic-os/HARNESS.md): reproduction entrypoints and live-run prerequisites

## Measurement and contributions

- [Metric definitions](https://github.com/tteon/gare2e/blob/main/docs/agentic-os/OBSERVABILITY_FACTORS.md): units, denominators and coverage
- [Query evidence](https://github.com/tteon/gare2e/blob/main/docs/agentic-os/GRAPH_OPTIMIZATION_OBSERVABILITY.md): query/plan/quality contracts
- [Graph-system observability](https://github.com/tteon/gare2e/blob/main/docs/agentic-os/GRAPH_SYSTEM_OBSERVABILITY.md): capability-qualified system evidence
- [Contributing](https://github.com/tteon/gare2e/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): source ownership and validation
- [Experiment agent guide](https://github.com/tteon/gare2e/blob/main/docs/agentic-os/AGENTS.md): preserve evidence, scope and resource boundaries

## Inherited SDK

- [SEOCHO](https://github.com/tteon/seocho): standalone ontology-aligned graph-memory SDK and upstream documentation
